geopolitics_summary: Hungary nuclear shutdown amid drought; Ukraine winter energy attacks risk; Trump oil price rhetoric fading; EU green spending commitments.

themes.headline: Hungary loses 40% power supply as Paks nuclear shuts due to drought
themes.why_it_matters: Danube cooling water shortage removes 2 GW dispatchable baseload from Central Europe; forces fuel-switch to gas and higher-cost imports. Direct upward pressure on DA/Cal+1 prices and Day-Ahead volatility across CEE-Germany.

themes.headline: Ukraine prepares for winter energy attacks, destroying Russian refineries mid-war
themes.why_it_matters: Escalating energy infrastructure war threatens European LNG supply chains and gas hub flows. Russian refinery capacity loss could tighten crude-to-fuel conversion, affecting LNG spot prices and TTF risk premium via sanctions/supply-chain uncertainty.

themes.headline: Italy pledges billions in green energy investment under relaxed EU fiscal rules
themes.why_it_matters: Large capacity injection signals accelerated renewable build; downward pressure on marginal pricing and merit-order effect in Southern Europe. Relevant for 2027–2028 Cal+1/Cal+2 curve and carbon spreads via reduced coal/gas need.

themes.headline: Trump's oil price talk losing clout as Republicans head toward midterms
themes.why_it_matters: Weakening US executive messaging on crude could permit Brent upside; indirectly raises LNG arbitrage to Europe and TTF floor. Secondary but material for 2–4 week LNG shipping economics and US Gulf LNG export pricing.

themes.headline: Spanish/French wildfires 20x more likely due to climate; Europe faces insurance crisis
themes.why_it_matters: Recurrent drought/heat risk impairs Iberian hydro availability and Danube nuclear cooling; repeated fire damage to transmission/distribution. Increases load volatility, reduces reliable capacity, and pushes DA/intraday spreads higher; EUA carbon floor may tighten as fuel-switching forces coal/gas.

watchlist: Danube water-level outlook; risk of further EU nuclear/hydro shutdowns in Sept–Oct.
Ukraine winter campaign timeline; LNG arbitrage & TTF risk premia.
Italian green capex auction calendar and transmission investment announcements.
Brent/WTI crude trend if Trump rhetoric continues to weaken; US LNG export pricing.
